Generate .wombo-combo/config.json in the current project

Minimal Ink confirmation screen that auto-detects project settings. Creates .wombo-combo/config.json, tasks/, and archive/ folder stores.

Aliases: `i`

```sh
woco init [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Overwrite existing config files |
